requested: review the completed v010 two-stage IDM then Planner implementation

review.scope: Independent final review of code, contracts, tests, module evidence, migration, and official consumers.

source_edits.scope: Bounded v010 two-stage training and consumer compatibility implementation.

report_write.scope: Local plans, contracts, tests, evidence, and review receipts.

repository_discipline.rationale: Contract-first owner boundaries, explicit lifecycle admission, schema isolation, and evidence-only claims apply.

dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Phase, trainer, workflow, collector, checkpoint, playback, and adaptation admission each retain one owner.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: One invocation selects one phase and optimizer; schema 4 exposes phase, completion, owner, and IDM digest.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Scripts compose owner APIs; phase and schema rules remain in distill owner modules.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Fresh output, alias, completion, tamper, and resume checks fail before forbidden mutation.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: v010 replaces alternating source training and updates only direct training, persistence, playback, and adaptation consumers.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: 18 two-stage and 173 impacted tests, Ruff, Pyright, diff check, and validated receipts establish offline correctness only.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Canonical IDM identity covers sorted key, dtype, shape, and CPU bytes and is checked by every schema-4 reader.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: IDM pretraining mutates only IDM; Planner training permanently seals IDM mode, gradients, parameters, and digest.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Schema 4 reaches official playback and stage transfer; Stage-C/D remain explicitly schema-3-only; v010 resume is rejected.

residual_risks.description: No current v010 formal runtime or live-route audit has run.
residual_risks.disposition: Run a fresh formal runtime audit before any authorized live execution.

residual_risks.description: Offline evidence does not establish IDM convergence, walking stability, or policy quality.
residual_risks.disposition: Evaluate IDM convergence before Planner training and audit policy quality after separately authorized runs.

residual_risks.description: Adaptation v002 intentionally admits schema 3 only.
residual_risks.disposition: Migrate adaptation authority separately before using a v010 schema-4 source in Stage-C/D.
